verdict.rationale: Rollbar's source-maps docs say minified JavaScript requires giving Rollbar access to your source maps, and that stack traces then show the original filename, line number, method name and code coordinates. This covers the de-minification outcome of the story. The pack never says how maps are uploaded, so the CI-driven CLI or bundler-plugin part is unproven. Missing for 10: any documented CLI or bundler-plugin (e.g., webpack/Vite) upload path, CI integration guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
